notes.title: PARKSIDE DEVBLOG: ROAD TO BETA
notes.content:
PARKSIDE DEVBLOG: ROAD TO BETA 


How's the development of PARKSIDE: DECAYED SOUL MANIPULATION going behind the scenes? Well, read this new devblog to find out just how close things are to "BETA"...



CLICK HERE TO READ THE DEVBLOG

notes.title: PARKSIDE Demo patch 1.41
notes.content:
Hi all, this is just a very minor tweak to hopefully fix the bug people have been having where input stops working, and also I've changed 'leaning' to toggle rather than press-and-hold. That's about it for this update.



-BananaH

notes.title: PARKSIDE DEMO PATCH 1.4
notes.content:
Hey folks. This patch is a bit more delayed than I wanted due to some computer issues but thankfully I'm back up and running again.



This patch addresses a number of small bugs and also attempts to fix the bug where the player suddenly can't attack or interact with things at random.

If this bug persists for you, please report it in the discussion board!



Patch notes:

- Updated player control in attempt to fix interaction freezing at higher framerates

- Fixed jumpy fast scrolling in Advancements menu

- Mission 1: Fixed geometry hole in water area, restarting and keeping XP and abilities bug, and Jonas Reeves infinite XP bug (I hope)

- Nightmare: Graphics options in pause menu work again.

- Mission 2: Fixed no collision on building near Discreet Club Sweet, and broken lightmap on nearby wall.

- Main Menu: Fixed bug where you can't click on anything after finishing the demo.



As always, have fun and thanks for playing.

-BananaH

notes.title: NEW PARKSIDE DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.content:
IT'S TIME!
Finally, I'm really excited to announce that the new PARKSIDE: DECAYED SOUL MANIPULATION demo is live! Among many other things, it features:



-New weapons to find and use

-A totally new inventory system, grid with drag-and-drop

-Character limb damage, status effects menu

-Intel menu with mission maps/details

-All character abilities and upgrades implemented and usable

-A new tutorial mission, also accessible via the introduction cutscene

-QOL: separate mouse invert axes and sensitivity, fixed control rebind errors, pausing in cutscenes, and much more!

-New NPCs and animations

-New enemy types: including leeches and helicopters

-Swimming!

-Driving cars!



AND MUCH MORE!



Get stuck in, and most importantly: enjoy! If you find any bugs or problems, feel free to report them on the Community Discussion Board!



Thanks for the continued support and have fun



-BananaH

notes.title: DEMO PATCH 1.2
notes.content:
Hi guys, this patch contains one or two essential changes and some more small bugfixes. It's intended to be the "final" version of the demo for a while. There are still imperfections but here is the list of changes:

-Added rebindable controls, which can be changed in the options menu (removed "Controls" option from the main menu) and in the pause menu (under "Controls")
-Instead of using Ctrl + A/D, the lean mechanic now uses two separate keys (Ctrl and Alt by default to lean left and right)
-Fixed a graphical bug with some electrical discharges
-Fixed a bug where Twist Grayson's store would explode immediately without a source of ignition when the gas is turned on
-Fixed a way to escape from the first mission and fall into the void
-Fixed an inventory/conversation screen conflict bug
-New ragdoll electrocution effect

There will not likely be any further patches to the demo until much closer to the game's final release. Be sure to follow me on X/Twitter at @BHardsoftGames if you want to stay in the loop. Please enjoy, and thank you for your support.

-EDIT: Lockpicks now no longer need to be equipped to be used on doors, etc.


-BananaH

notes.title: DEMO PATCH 1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who's played the demo so far. This patch includes a short, yet important list of improvements:

-Fixed an infinite XP glitch in the first mission.
-Added separate "Invert Mouse X" and "Invert Mouse Y" options.
-Added an option to view the controls to the in-game pause menu.
-Fixed the main menu UI cutting off in 21:9 aspect ratio
-Fixed a scrambled dialogue bug (90% sure on this one!)
-Fixed a bug where refusing to kill Jonas or talking to him too much would taint future dialogue despite restarting the mission.

If you haven't played the demo yet, I hope you enjoy it. I'm excited for what the future of PARKSIDE will bring.

-BananaH
